# RAR fixtures

Created from synthetic project-owned data using the official RAR 7.23 trial command-line tool. No Minecraft binaries, accounts or real mods are included. game-solid.rar uses RAR5 solid compression, a 4 MiB dictionary, Chinese paths and a version profile. modrinth.rar checks override priority. The encrypted fixtures use the test-only password test-only. split.part1.rar intentionally contains only the first volume.

Regenerate with node scripts/make-rar-fixtures.mjs <Rar.exe>. The test suite uses these checked-in files and requires no external archiver. Stored RAR4 boundary fixtures are generated by tests/helpers/rar4.mjs.
